analysis: Examined both files' metadata, patches and all supplied source excerpts against the canonical index and detailed T-041. docs/reference/ssd-kv-cache.md:377 (head patch) documents retirement in 16-file slices, releasing the removal lock and epoch barrier between slices, rechecking ownership and ending on refusal. changelog.d/ssd-retirement-in-slices.md:3-9 describes reduced lookup/publication blocking and a slightly longer background sweep; these measurements do not establish a latency guarantee. No concrete security regression is supported by these documentation changes. They do not change the documented TTL, authenticated scope, HMAC names, AES-GCM, KEK purge, staging bounds, write budget or serving authorization. Existing retention and same-account timing limitations under T-041 remain relevant, as does availability asset A-018. Implementation is not supplied in this batch: integration should verify SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.removeInSlices, SSDCacheEpochStore.performOwnedRetirement and SSDDiskBudget.retireActiveEntries preserve per-slice epoch/binding validation, nonwaiting file leases, unlink/index/accounting coordination and close/disown refusal. Also verify concurrent lookup, donor publication and root replacement cannot cause stale victims to delete newly published entries after locks are released. These are unresolved implementation contracts, not observed missing controls or findings.
